proposed.text: A building load exceeds the bearing capacity of the supporting soil near the surface. Which foundation type is suitable to evaluate first, and why?

options.text: Shallow footing, because any low bearing capacity can be ignored if the building is small.

Pile or caisson foundation, because loads must be transferred to more suitable material or carried through pile-soil resistance when shallow bearing is inadequate.
A specialty excavation-balance system, because every building reduces soil stress after excavation.
